```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)

counts_path <- "work/06_counts/alt_counts_edit.csv"
meta_path   <- "work/06_counts/sample_table_edit.csv"

cts  <- read.csv(counts_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(meta_path,   check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Long table: one row = mutation feature in one sample
cts_long <- cts %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -feature,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "mut_count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
    feature,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("pos", "change"),
    too_few = "error"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pos = as.integer(pos),
    replicate = factor(replicate),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("R", "X"))
  )

# Restrict to minimal-element windows
cts_long <- cts_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (virus == "ZIKV" & pos >= 29 & pos <= 107) |
    (virus == "DENV" & pos >= 28 & pos <= 104)
  )

# Optional low-count filter:
# keep mutation features with at least 20 total counts across all samples of that virus
feature_totals <- cts_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(virus, pos, change) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_mut_count = sum(mut_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature_id = paste(pos, change, sep = "_"))

keep_zikv <- feature_totals %>%
  dplyr::filter(virus == "ZIKV", total_mut_count >= 20) %>%
  dplyr::pull(feature_id)

keep_denv <- feature_totals %>%
  dplyr::filter(virus == "DENV", total_mut_count >= 20) %>%
  dplyr::pull(feature_id)

cts_long <- cts_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature_id = paste(pos, change, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (virus == "ZIKV" & feature_id %in% keep_zikv) |
    (virus == "DENV" & feature_id %in% keep_denv)
  )

# CRISPR-style normalization:
# frequency of each mutation among all mutation-feature counts in that sample
# then log2-transform with pseudocount
pseudocount <- 1e-6

cts_long <- cts_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample_total_mut = sum(mut_count),
    mut_freq = mut_count / sample_total_mut,
    log_freq = log2(mut_freq + pseudocount)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Split by virus
cts_long_zikv <- cts_long %>% dplyr::filter(virus == "ZIKV")
cts_long_denv <- cts_long %>% dplyr::filter(virus == "DENV")

meta_zikv <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(virus == "ZIKV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    replicate = factor(replicate),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("R", "X"))
  )

meta_denv <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(virus == "DENV") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    replicate = factor(replicate),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("R", "X"))
  )

# Build limma matrices
mat_zikv <- cts_long_zikv %>%
  dplyr::select(feature_id, sample, log_freq) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = log_freq) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

mat_denv <- cts_long_denv %>%
  dplyr::select(feature_id, sample, log_freq) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = log_freq) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Reorder metadata to match matrix columns
meta_zikv <- meta_zikv[match(colnames(mat_zikv), meta_zikv$sample), , drop = FALSE]
meta_denv <- meta_denv[match(colnames(mat_denv), meta_denv$sample), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(all(colnames(mat_zikv) == meta_zikv$sample))
stopifnot(all(colnames(mat_denv) == meta_denv$sample))

# Design matrices
design_zikv <- model.matrix(~ replicate + condition, data = meta_zikv)
design_denv <- model.matrix(~ replicate + condition, data = meta_denv)

# Limma fits
fit_zikv <- limma::lmFit(mat_zikv, design_zikv)
fit_zikv <- limma::eBayes(fit_zikv)
zikv_res_drop <- limma::topTable(fit_zikv, coef = "conditionX", number = Inf)

fit_denv <- limma::lmFit(mat_denv, design_denv)
fit_denv <- limma::eBayes(fit_denv)
denv_res_drop <- limma::topTable(fit_denv, coef = "conditionX", number = Inf)

# Tidy for plotting
zikv_res_drop <- zikv_res_drop %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(feature_id, delim = "_", names = c("pos", "change"), too_few = "error") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pos = as.integer(pos),
    neglog10padj = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    neglog10padj = ifelse(is.finite(neglog10padj), neglog10padj, NA_real_),
    neglog10padj_cap = pmin(neglog10padj, 10),
    mutant_base = sub(".*>", "", change),
    mutant_base = gsub("T", "U", mutant_base)
  )

denv_res_drop <- denv_res_drop %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(feature_id, delim = "_", names = c("pos", "change"), too_few = "error") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pos = as.integer(pos),
    neglog10padj = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    neglog10padj = ifelse(is.finite(neglog10padj), neglog10padj, NA_real_),
    neglog10padj_cap = pmin(neglog10padj, 10),
    mutant_base = sub(".*>", "", change),
    mutant_base = gsub("T", "U", mutant_base)
  )

# Quick summaries
cat("\nZIKV dropout logFC summary:\n")
print(summary(zikv_res_drop$logFC))

cat("\nDENV dropout logFC summary:\n")
print(summary(denv_res_drop$logFC))

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

plot_dropout_bubbles <- function(res_df, title = NULL) {
  base_colors <- c(
    A = "#2ca25f",
    U = "#de2d26",
    C = "#fdae6b",
    G = "#3182bd"
  )

  xpos <- seq(min(res_df$pos), max(res_df$pos), by = 1)

  ggplot(res_df, aes(x = pos, y = logFC)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = neglog10padj_cap, fill = mutant_base),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.2,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = base_colors,
      breaks = c("A", "U", "C", "G"),
      name = "Mutant base"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "-log10(adj.P.Val)",
      range = c(1.2, 5.5)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = xpos,
      expand = expansion(add = c(1, 1))
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Dropout log2FC (X vs R)"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
    )
}

make_full_track_df <- function(pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket, mut_start, mut_end) {
  tibble(
    pos = pos_start:(pos_start + nchar(seq_rna) - 1),
    base = strsplit(seq_rna, "")[[1]],
    db = strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]],
    region = ifelse(pos >= mut_start & pos <= mut_end, "mutated", "constant")
  )
}

plot_full_track <- function(track_df, label_every = 5) {
  labs_df <- track_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(show = (pos - min(pos)) %% label_every == 0)

  xpos <- seq(min(track_df$pos), max(track_df$pos), by = 1)

  ggplot() +
    geom_text(
      data = track_df,
      aes(x = pos, y = 0, label = db, color = region),
      size = 3.3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = track_df,
      aes(x = pos, y = -1, label = base, color = region),
      size = 3.3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = labs_df %>% dplyr::filter(show),
      aes(x = pos, y = 1, label = pos),
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(mutated = "black", constant = "grey60")) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = xpos,
      expand = expansion(add = c(1, 1))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 0, -1),
      labels = c("pos", "db", "seq")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Position", y = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
    )
}

make_dropout_bubble_with_track <- function(res_df, pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket,
                                           mut_start, mut_end,
                                           title, out_pdf,
                                           label_every = 5,
                                           width = 20, height = 5) {
  track_df <- make_full_track_df(
    pos_start = pos_start,
    seq_rna = seq_rna,
    dotbracket = dotbracket,
    mut_start = mut_start,
    mut_end = mut_end
  )

  p_top <- plot_dropout_bubbles(res_df, title = title)
  p_bot <- plot_full_track(track_df, label_every = label_every)

  combined <- p_top / p_bot + plot_layout(heights = c(2.4, 1))
  ggsave(out_pdf, combined, width = width, height = height)
  combined
}
```
